entries.zh: 上坡、爬坡；山势陡斜崎岖
entries.en: uphill, up the slope; steep and rugged (path)
entries.notes: 西语词头尾部残缺（fragos…），据崎、斜与 cuesta arriba 定为陡斜上坡义。

entries.en: rock, crag; cliff
entries.notes: 西语词头残缺且与汉字对应不明，据 H 岩、R 栏对音定为岩石义，存疑。

entries.en: cave, hole; cavern in the crags
cave, grotto; hollow in the rocks
entries.notes: 西语词头 cuema 疑为 cueva 之误，词义据 H 峒及闽南、官话两音栏（lǒng/tōng）定为山洞。

entries.en: rock, crag
valley; hollow between mountains
entries.notes: 西语 cuena en los montes（洞在山中）与 H 山谷之义不尽吻合，据 H 与两音栏（sān cog/sān cō）定为山谷。

entries.zh: 地网；地面罗网（捕鸟兽的陷阱网）
entries.en: ground-net; snare, net spread on the ground
entries.notes: 西语栏严重损讹难读，据 H 地網及两音栏（těy bòng/tī vâng）定为地面罗网义。

entries.en: to think, to ponder; to miss (someone)
to peep, to spy; to watch stealthily

entries.zh: 谨、谨慎；小心行事、戒慎自守
entries.en: to be careful; to act cautiously, to guard oneself

entries.zh: 业、业行；善业（行善之业报）；营生、行业
entries.en: deeds, actions; (good) karma; occupation, trade
entries.notes: 西语释义（行善自守）与 H 業之义仅部分吻合，取业行、善业义。

entries.zh: 斟酌、斟量；权衡考虑（原稿作斟，疑为勘）
entries.en: to weigh, to consider; to deliberate
entries.notes: 封存件标 [疑:勘]，据闽南栏 chím 取斟酌权衡义。

entries.zh: 奖、奖励；劝勉、褒奖（奖其职事）
entries.en: to reward; to encourage, to commend (in one's office or duty)
entries.notes: 西语释义（照管某项职事）与 H 獎不甚吻合，疑有字讹，据 H 及两音栏（chiāng）定为奖。

entries.en: to look after, to attend to; to care for
to respond to; to attend to, to deal with (affairs)
diligent; to be diligent and careful
entries.notes: 西语释义（照管且有理）与 H 勤之义部分吻合；闽南栏记多重读音（勤谨等），取勤勉义。

entries.en: to supervise, to oversee
careful, cautious; to take care
to strive, to exert oneself; diligent
〔Original damaged, gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: 西语词头两处残缺、各栏疑串行（闽南栏混入 razonar），H 間与释义无法对应，无法定夺。

entries.zh: 思虑、考虑；思量（原稿作恖，虑之古体，疑为思）
entries.en: to think over, to consider; to take thought for
entries.notes: 封存件标 [疑:思]，原稿字作恖（虑之古体），据闽南、官话两音栏（sū/zǔ）取思虑义。

entries.en: to preside over, to superintend; to manage (as a superior)
